approach: I followed DE-05 in the data-engineering-steps skill. First I read both contracted inputs: task.components from DE-04 and the feature override of org.data_model. I also read the organisation's baseline org/org.data_model.md so I could compare the model before and after the feature. I used context_get to read the approved feat.design as background, which gives a receipt for its record contracts (DC-1, DC-2, B1.2 to B1.4, DD-6, DD-7, NF-4). I read the ingestion and transformation code and its call path through the codegraph MCP connector (codegraph_explore with the ap_pipeline projectPath), and checked it against the tool view. I ran the baseline CI (`/usr/bin/python3 ci.py`), and it passed. The output covers: the change to the source system, the Invoice entity before and after, the paid_date attribute specification, the new reject reason, the derived delay-history view, a knowledge-graph diagram, compatibility, and a column-to-attribute handover for DE-06. I changed no code, because task.components assigns the implementation to TSK-01 and TSK-02 in DE-08. Where the baseline model and the override differ, I raised the difference as an open question rather than resolving it myself.
